summary: Practise delegation, GROW coaching, feedback and conflict tools for nonprofit teams. Explore the five-day course and its applied exercises.
lede: Nonprofit leadership training helps programme managers, team leads and volunteer coordinators guide mixed staff-volunteer teams and align daily work with mission priorities. You’ll practise mapping decision rights with RACI, coaching with GROW, and preparing delegation, feedback, conflict-response and stakeholder-update tools for programme delivery with limited resources.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate nonprofit programmes, lead mixed staff-volunteer teams or support mission delivery through people-management responsibilities.
modules: RACI Decision Rights for Programme Teams
Bridges Transition Model for Programme Change
prerequisites: Experience coordinating programme work, staff or volunteers will help you apply the exercises. No coding or specialist software is required.
